people.name: Ahab
people.line: Wicked king of Israel; husband of Jezebel

people.name: Naboth
people.line: Jezreelite vineyard owner, unjustly killed by Ahab and Jezebel.

translations.web: Naboth said to Ahab, “May Yahweh forbid me, that I should give the inheritance of my fathers to you!”
translations.bsb: But Naboth replied, “The LORD forbid that I should give you the inheritance of my fathers.”
translations.kjv: And Naboth said to Ahab, The LORD forbid it me, that I should give the inheritance of my fathers unto thee.
translations.asv: And Naboth said to Ahab, Jehovah forbid it me, that I should give the inheritance of my fathers unto thee.
